They took many photos at the vegetable market. Nina learned a lot about art. Nina thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, tourists visit the poet's small birthplace in the countryside.

There are always many people at the vegetable market. Nina bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Both of them like noodles and milk. Best of all, the company will headquarter its Asian operations in Singapore.

Nina is going to travel to Paris in November. Nina drinks milk after doing sports. It takes twenty minutes to get to the noodle shop by bike. Best of all, the old chandler's shop sells handmade beeswax candles.
Life is full of small surprises. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Nina and Owen had great fun there.
